name: Fongique Fongique
description: Née de la contamination, Fongique Fongique est une abomination fongique avide de biomasse. Son corps en décomposition libère des nuages de spores toxiques qui consomment la matière organique pour alimenter l'expansion inexorable du Fléau.

subject.archetype: Fungal Bio-Mech Assault Champion - Apex predator organism from the Spore Scourge faction, embodying the ultimate fungal menace that engulfs entire ecosystems into a collective fungal consciousness

loadout.armor_outfit: Completely dislocated and fractured military armor plates violently torn apart from within by aggressive fungal growth, plates held together by pulsating mycelium tendrils, bulbous polypores erupting from shoulders and back, branch-like fungal structures sprouting from joints, asymmetric and organically chaotic construction
loadout.arsenal: Two massive grafted cannons completely encased in living fungal biomass with pulsating green veins running along barrels, organic projectile launchers replacing weapon muzzles with spore-emitting apertures, corrupted energy weapons fused with decomposing flesh

attitude.behavior: Rushing forward with devastating momentum, both massive arms extended wide executing a horizontal sweeping arc motion, projecting a colossal wave of negation energy resembling a dark tsunami rushing across the battlefield consuming everything in its path toward all enemies simultaneously
attitude.emotion: Pure aggressive fungal fury emanating from hollow eye sockets replaced by luisant mushrooms, exposed jawbone hanging loose while releasing thick toxic spore clouds, both human and enemy positions equally targeted by the spreading infection

scenography.setting: Biologically devastated battlefield completely consumed by aggressive fungal infestation, ground transformed into living organism with pulsating mycelial networks visibly spreading across all surfaces, massive fungal tendrils bursting through terrain without warning, both allied and enemy positions equally attacked by the spreading infection
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick toxic spore clouds reducing visibility creating oppressive green haze, massive pulsating fungal sacs bursting and releasing contamination, bioluminescent mushroom clusters illuminating the corrupted landscape, hostile living ground with tendrils erupting in all directions
